title: Final-year ChatGPT Dart Snooker Scoring critique
summary: Final-year degree apprentices prompt ChatGPT to generate a Dart Snooker Scoring application and compare it with an application they built for another module. They mark the generated result with the original rubric, rate it, analyze required modifications, and estimate time savings.
